verdict: Organic is your only active channel, and it slowed sharply this week.
narrative: All activity this period came from organic sources — paid advertising has been at $0 for the full 28 days, so there is no paid support behind any of your results. Your Google Business Profile generated 153 total actions this period (61 calls, 60 direction requests, 32 website clicks), but actions fell 36.6% week-over-week, and the last three days registered zero activity — a meaningful drop that lines up with a 35% decline in search clicks and a roughly 45% dip in website sessions over the same short window. The 135 CRM contacts recorded this period are encouraging as a base, but none have converted to booked appointments yet, so we're looking closely at where those contacts are falling out of the intake process. Restoring search visibility and closing that intake gap are the two priorities heading into the next period.
